title: docs(readme): add UI screenshots, architecture diagram, and homepage polish
body:
## What

Adds visuals and polish to the homepage README.

- **See it in action** — framed browser-window screenshots of the Console & Studio (dashboard, kanban, Gantt, calendar, gallery, object & flow designers, AI assistant), captured from the live `showcase` + HotCRM apps.
- **How it works** — a generated architecture diagram (typed metadata → compiled artifact → REST / SDK / Console & Studio / MCP, governed by Auth / RBAC / RLS / FLS / audit) plus a real `ObjectSchema` code sample.
- **Accuracy** — fix stale Codebase Metrics (source packages 51 → 72, test files 229 → 676).
- **Tighten** — de-duplicate the "built for AI / ~100× less code" messaging; collapse the long Package Directory into a `<details>` block.

Assets live under `docs/screenshots/` (per the `.gitignore` convention). Docs-only change — no source code touched.
